The presentation fits irritable bowel syndrome with mixed bowel habits, affecting the colon. Sympathetic fibers to the colon arise from preganglionic neurons in the intermediolateral cell column of the thoracolumbar spinal cord (roughly T10–L2). They travel through the thoracic and lumbar splanchnic nerves to synapse in prevertebral ganglia (mainly superior and inferior mesenteric).

CONFIDENCE: 65
